# HostLabo

> HostLabo is Iwo Dec, in Poland, making small self-contained things that run on the device
> in front of you rather than on somebody's server. No accounts, no subscriptions, nothing
> to sign in to.

## What is here

- **Hplay** — https://iwohost.github.io/hplaysite/
  A music player for Android, for the audio files already on the phone. Driven by a scroll
  wheel rather than a list. Every folder of music becomes a playlist named after the folder.
  Free, downloaded as an APK rather than from an app store. There is a full description,
  a changelog and a download on that page, and an llms.txt of its own beside it at
  https://iwohost.github.io/hplaysite/llms.txt

- **HostLab** — https://iwohost.github.io/HostLab/
  Browser tools and experiments, each one a page that runs where you opened it.

Everything else, including what is still only source, is at https://github.com/IwoHost
